description: Weak, mixed layer-0 unit keyed to move order rather than tactics. It fires (1) when the opponent's last move was in the centre column 3 at ply 4 or 5, (2) right after an opening move in column 1, and (3) late in the game (ply 20+) when it is the first player's turn and the edge columns 0 and 6 hold many stones (about 9+), unless the last move was in column 0. Odd late plies are strongly negative.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by under 0.01 on all tested positions.
notes: Best dev F1 0.369 (P 0.263, R 0.623, AUROC 0.785), simulation share 0.58. last_col==3 alone F1 0.12. Activation range tiny (dev max 0.006). Depends on ply parity/position, last token and edge-column token counts; additive score had AUROC 0.86 but worse F1. Possibly a random direction; no clean board concept. No synthesis beat the dev max (best 0.005).
